name: Introduction and overview — P-51 Mustang — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — P-51 Mustang
description: Introduction and overview of the P-51 Mustang: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The P-51 Mustang is a single-engine long-range fighter built by North American, the escort fighter that made the U.S. daylight bombing campaign over Germany sustainable. The Merlin-engined P-51D could escort bombers all the way to Berlin and back. Over 15,000 were built; it is often called the best all-around fighter of World War II. Baseline facts: Single-engine long-range escort fighter; 15,000+ built by North American; Berlin-and-back range..
